author: deep_technical
text: The biggest footgun in C++ is not pointers or memory management. It is undefined behavior. The compiler is allowed to assume UB never happens and will optimize around it in ways that completely break your mental model of what the code does. This is why you need sanitizers in your build pipeline from day one.
